name: CCPA / CPRA
description: California Consumer Privacy Act and California Privacy Rights Act — California state privacy law giving consumers rights over their personal information and imposing obligations on businesses.

controls.title: Right to Know
controls.description: Consumers have the right to know what personal information is collected, used, shared, or sold. Businesses must provide notice at or before the point of collection.

controls.title: Right to Delete
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request deletion of their personal information collected by the business, subject to exceptions.

controls.title: Right to Opt-Out of Sale
controls.description: Consumers have the right to opt-out of the sale of their personal information. Businesses must provide a 'Do Not Sell My Personal Information' link.

controls.title: Right to Non-Discrimination
controls.description: Businesses cannot discriminate against consumers who exercise their CCPA rights, including denying goods or services, charging different prices, or providing different quality.

controls.title: Right to Correct
controls.description: Consumers have the right to request correction of inaccurate personal information maintained by the business.

controls.title: Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information
controls.description: Consumers have the right to limit the use and disclosure of sensitive personal information to certain purposes.

controls.title: Sensitive Personal Information
controls.description: Businesses must provide notice and obtain opt-in consent for processing sensitive personal information beyond defined permitted purposes.

controls.title: Privacy Notice Requirements
controls.description: Businesses must provide a comprehensive privacy notice that discloses categories of personal information collected, purposes of collection, categories of third parties data is shared with.

controls.title: Service Provider Contracts
controls.description: Businesses must have contracts with service providers that prohibit the service provider from retaining, using, or disclosing personal information outside the business relationship.

controls.title: Verification of Requests
controls.description: Businesses must implement a verifiable consumer request process that allows consumers to exercise their rights without creating excessive friction.

controls.title: Response Timeframes
controls.description: Businesses must respond to consumer requests within 45 days (extendable by 45 more days). Businesses must disclose if they cannot fulfill the request.

controls.title: Risk Assessments
controls.description: Businesses must conduct and document risk assessments for processing activities that present significant risk to consumers' privacy.

controls.title: Automated Decision-Making Technology
controls.description: Consumers have the right to opt-out of automated decision-making technology that produces legal or similarly significant decisions.

controls.title: Data Security
controls.description: Businesses must implement reasonable security measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or destruction.
